title: monarda fistulosa var. menthifolia
intro: Monarda fistulosa var. menthifolia, commonly known as Wild Bergamot, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include relieving anxiety and stress, while also providing antioxidant and anti-inflammatory benefits for the body. The therapeutic actions of Wild Bergamot include its antispasmodic and sedative properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Monarda fistulosa var. menthifolia include monoterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its potential health benefits.
